en.t: Before long, the small boat reached the opposite shore.

units.source_text: 下船之时，匂亲王舍不得把浮舟让别人抱，便亲自抱了她上岸，而叫别人扶持自身。

en.t: When they got out of the boat, Prince Niou could not bear to let anyone else carry Ukifune, so he carried her ashore himself and had others support him.

units.source_text: 看见的人想道：“这样子真难看啊！

en.t: Those who saw it thought, "How unseemly this looks!

units.source_text: 这女子毕竟是谁，值得如此宠爱？”

en.t: Who in the world is this woman, that she deserves such devotion?"

units.source_text: 这屋子是时方的叔父因幡守领地内的别庄，建筑不甚讲究，而且尚未竣工。

en.t: This house was a villa on the estate of Tokikata's uncle, the Governor of Inaba; it was not especially finely built, and it was not yet finished.

units.source_text: 因此设备亦颇简陋，那些竹编屏风等，都是匂亲王从未见过的粗货，风也不能全防。

en.t: For that reason, the furnishings too were quite plain; things such as the bamboo-woven screens were crude articles Prince Niou had never seen before, and they could not fully keep out the wind.

units.source_text: 墙根的雪已经消融得斑斑驳驳，但此时天色阴晦，又下雪了。

en.t: The snow along the base of the walls had already melted into patchy remnants, but now the sky was dark and overcast, and snow began to fall again.
